kit.text:
Every Google Analytics screen, redrawn on 10 Oct 2026 for review page by page.

Top row: the screens with figures. Bottom row: the states people meet on the way — connecting, choosing, the first collection, a device asked of Google, reconnecting, and the bell.

Ronins' real figures for the last 30 days: Google Analytics to 9 Oct, Search Console to 8 Oct. Long lists open at 25 rows, with the 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 choice, as built.

Each screen with figures opens with What Hakken sees: what an SEO specialist would say about that screen's figures, and what to do first.

Click through it: the side menu, the rows and the headings work.

Drawn from the drawing kit: stylesheet d9c1f591dab2, look 149d9f4fb243.

states.text:
Not kept, so drawn as stand-ins: how many properties the Google account can see (3) and the list behind "See all". Hakken forgets them once a property is chosen.

Choose what counts shows the ticks as Hakken would set them for Ronins today: only Purchase, because Ronins' own event names aren't on Hakken's list of likely conversions.

Not connected yet has two switches in its settings: who is looking (an admin or not) and whether Search Console is connected.
